title: Black Hole Painting
description: A painting shows a large black hole with a jagged torn edge in the center of swirling dark space. Many metallic spheres of different sizes float around the hole and in the surrounding dark void with small white dots.
prompt: A painting of a large black hole in the center of space with a jagged torn ragged blue edge around the perfect black circle. Metallic silver spheres of various sizes float and orbit around the black hole and throughout the dark background with small white dots and subtle light swirls, dark cosmic scene in plain style.
